question: What are the two types of electric charge?
urdu_translation: electric charge کی two types کون سی ہیں؟
A: Positive and negative / positive اور negative
B: North and south / north اور south
C: Hot and cold / hot اور cold
D: Real and virtual / real اور virtual
correct_answer: A | Positive and negative / positive اور negative

question: What happens between like charges?
urdu_translation: like charges کے درمیان کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: They attract / وہ attract کرتی ہیں
B: They become neutral immediately / وہ immediately neutral ہو جاتی ہیں
C: They produce no force / وہ no force produce کرتی ہیں
D: They repel / وہ repel کرتی ہیں
correct_answer: D | They repel / وہ repel کرتی ہیں

question: What happens between unlike charges?
urdu_translation: unlike charges کے درمیان کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: They attract / وہ attract کرتی ہیں
B: They repel / وہ repel کرتی ہیں
C: They always disappear / وہ ہمیشہ disappear ہو جاتی ہیں
D: They form a magnetic pole only / وہ صرف magnetic pole بناتی ہیں
correct_answer: A | They attract / وہ attract کرتی ہیں

question: What is the SI unit of electric charge?
urdu_translation: electric charge کی SI unit کیا ہے؟
A: Coulomb (C) / coulomb (C)
B: Newton (N) / newton (N)
C: Volt (V) / volt (V)
D: Ohm (Ω) / ohm (Ω)
correct_answer: A | Coulomb (C) / coulomb (C)

question: What does conservation of charge state?
urdu_translation: conservation of charge کیا state کرتی ہے؟
A: Charge is always created from nothing / charge ہمیشہ nothing سے create ہوتی ہے
B: Positive charge can never move / positive charge کبھی move نہیں کر سکتی
C: Total charge always becomes zero / total charge ہمیشہ zero ہو جاتی ہے
D: Charge cannot be created or destroyed, only transferred / charge create یا destroy نہیں، صرف transfer ہو سکتی ہے
correct_answer: D | Charge cannot be created or destroyed, only transferred / charge create یا destroy نہیں، صرف transfer ہو سکتی ہے

question: When two materials are rubbed, which particles are usually transferred?
urdu_translation: two materials rub کرنے پر usually کون سے particles transfer ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Protons from nuclei / nuclei سے protons
B: Electrons / electrons
C: Neutrons / neutrons
D: Photons only / صرف photons
correct_answer: B | Electrons / electrons

question: What is electrostatic induction?
urdu_translation: electrostatic induction کیا ہے؟
A: Charging only by rubbing / صرف rubbing سے charging
B: Redistribution of charge without contact / contact کے بغیر charge redistribution
C: Current through a resistor / resistor میں current
D: Magnetic field production / magnetic field production
correct_answer: B | Redistribution of charge without contact / contact کے بغیر charge redistribution

question: What happens inside a neutral conductor when a charged rod is brought near?
urdu_translation: charged rod کو neutral conductor کے near لانے پر اندر کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: Charges separate within the conductor / conductor کے اندر charges separate ہوتی ہیں
B: All electrons leave permanently / تمام electrons permanently leave کرتی ہیں
C: Nuclei move to the surface / nuclei surface پر move کرتے ہیں
D: No charge distribution changes / charge distribution change نہیں ہوتی
correct_answer: A | Charges separate within the conductor / conductor کے اندر charges separate ہوتی ہیں

question: What is earthing?
urdu_translation: earthing کیا ہے؟
A: Connecting an object to Earth to allow charge flow / object کو Earth سے connect کرکے charge flow allow کرنا
B: Heating an object / object کو heat کرنا
C: Creating a magnetic pole / magnetic pole create کرنا
D: Blocking all electrons / تمام electrons block کرنا
correct_answer: A | Connecting an object to Earth to allow charge flow / object کو Earth سے connect کرکے charge flow allow کرنا

question: Which instrument detects electric charge?
urdu_translation: electric charge detect کرنے والا instrument کون سا ہے؟
A: Ammeter / ammeter
B: Thermometer / thermometer
C: Barometer / barometer
D: Gold-leaf electroscope / gold-leaf electroscope
correct_answer: D | Gold-leaf electroscope / gold-leaf electroscope

question: Why do the leaves of a charged electroscope diverge?
urdu_translation: charged electroscope کی leaves diverge کیوں کرتی ہیں؟
A: They acquire unlike charges and attract / وہ unlike charges acquire کرکے attract کرتی ہیں
B: Gravity stops acting / gravity stop کرتی ہے
C: They acquire like charges and repel / وہ like charges acquire کرکے repel کرتی ہیں
D: They become magnets / وہ magnets بن جاتی ہیں
correct_answer: C | They acquire like charges and repel / وہ like charges acquire کرکے repel کرتی ہیں

question: If a known positive rod makes electroscope leaves diverge further, the electroscope is likely:
urdu_translation: known positive rod leaves کو further diverge کرے تو electroscope likely کس charge پر ہے؟
A: Negatively charged / negatively charged
B: Always neutral / ہمیشہ neutral
C: Positively charged / positively charged
D: Uncharged and earthed / uncharged اور earthed
correct_answer: C | Positively charged / positively charged

question: Which device uses electrostatic charges to make copies?
urdu_translation: copies بنانے کے لیے electrostatic charges کون سا device use کرتا ہے؟
A: Transformer / transformer
B: Electric motor / electric motor
C: Photocopier / photocopier
D: Thermos flask / thermos flask
correct_answer: C | Photocopier / photocopier

question: What is the purpose of an electrostatic precipitator?
urdu_translation: electrostatic precipitator کا purpose کیا ہے؟
A: Producing sound waves / sound waves produce کرنا
B: Increasing liquid temperature / liquid temperature increase کرنا
C: Measuring current / current measure کرنا
D: Removing smoke and dust particles from gases / gases سے smoke اور dust particles remove کرنا
correct_answer: D | Removing smoke and dust particles from gases / gases سے smoke اور dust particles remove کرنا

question: Why can electrostatic spray painting give an even coating?
urdu_translation: electrostatic spray painting even coating کیوں دیتی ہے؟
A: Paint droplets become weightless / paint droplets weightless ہو جاتی ہیں
B: All charge is removed before spraying / spraying سے پہلے تمام charge remove ہوتی ہے
C: Sound pressure spreads paint / sound pressure paint spread کرتا ہے
D: Charged droplets are attracted to the oppositely charged object / charged droplets oppositely charged object کی طرف attract ہوتی ہیں
correct_answer: D | Charged droplets are attracted to the oppositely charged object / charged droplets oppositely charged object کی طرف attract ہوتی ہیں

question: What does Coulomb's law describe?
urdu_translation: Coulomb's law کیا describe کرتا ہے؟
A: Current through a resistor / resistor میں current
B: Refraction of light / light refraction
C: Heat capacity of water / water heat capacity
D: Force between two point charges / two point charges کے درمیان force
correct_answer: D | Force between two point charges / two point charges کے درمیان force

question: Which formula represents Coulomb's law?
urdu_translation: Coulomb's law کا formula کون سا ہے؟
A: F = kq₁q₂/r²
B: F = kq₁q₂/r
C: F = kr²/q₁q₂
D: F = q₁ + q₂
correct_answer: A | F = kq₁q₂/r²

question: How does electrostatic force change if distance between charges doubles?
urdu_translation: charges کے درمیان distance double ہونے پر electrostatic force کیسے change ہوتی ہے؟
A: It doubles / یہ double ہو جاتی ہے
B: It becomes one-fourth / یہ one-fourth ہو جاتی ہے
C: It becomes four times / یہ four times ہو جاتی ہے
D: It remains unchanged / یہ unchanged رہتی ہے
correct_answer: B | It becomes one-fourth / یہ one-fourth ہو جاتی ہے

question: How does force change if one charge is doubled while distance is unchanged?
urdu_translation: one charge double اور distance unchanged ہو تو force کیسے change ہوتی ہے؟
A: It becomes one-half / یہ one-half ہو جاتی ہے
B: It doubles / یہ double ہو جاتی ہے
C: It becomes one-fourth / یہ one-fourth ہو جاتی ہے
D: It becomes zero / یہ zero ہو جاتی ہے
correct_answer: B | It doubles / یہ double ہو جاتی ہے

question: Two charges are separated by r. If both charges double, the force becomes:
urdu_translation: two charges distance r پر ہوں۔ دونوں charges double ہوں تو force کیا ہوگی؟
A: Four times / four times
B: Two times / two times
C: One-fourth / one-fourth
D: Unchanged / unchanged
correct_answer: A | Four times / four times

question: What is an electric field?
urdu_translation: electric field کیا ہے؟
A: Region with no forces / region with no forces
B: Path of heat conduction / heat conduction کا path
C: Only a magnetic material / صرف magnetic material
D: Region where an electric charge experiences force / region جہاں electric charge force experience کرتی ہے
correct_answer: D | Region where an electric charge experiences force / region جہاں electric charge force experience کرتی ہے

question: Which formula defines electric field intensity?
urdu_translation: electric field intensity کا formula کون سا ہے؟
A: E = Fq
B: E = F/q
C: E = q/F
D: E = Fr
correct_answer: B | E = F/q

question: What is the SI unit of electric field intensity?
urdu_translation: electric field intensity کی SI unit کیا ہے؟
A: C/N
B: J/C
C: N/C
D: A/s
correct_answer: C | N/C

question: In which direction do electric field lines point?
urdu_translation: electric field lines کس direction میں point کرتی ہیں؟
A: From positive charge to negative charge / positive charge سے negative charge
B: From negative to positive only / negative سے positive
C: In closed circles around charge / charge کے around closed circles
D: Randomly without direction / randomly without direction
correct_answer: A | From positive charge to negative charge / positive charge سے negative charge

question: Can electric field lines intersect?
urdu_translation: کیا electric field lines intersect کر سکتی ہیں؟
A: Yes, at every point / ہاں، ہر point پر
B: Only in vacuum / صرف vacuum میں
C: No / نہیں
D: Only around negative charges / صرف negative charges کے around
correct_answer: C | No / نہیں

question: What does closer spacing of field lines indicate?
urdu_translation: field lines کی closer spacing کیا indicate کرتی ہے؟
A: Stronger electric field / stronger electric field
B: Weaker electric field / weaker electric field
C: Zero charge always / ہمیشہ zero charge
D: Higher temperature only / صرف higher temperature
correct_answer: A | Stronger electric field / stronger electric field

question: What is the field like between large oppositely charged parallel plates?
urdu_translation: large oppositely charged parallel plates کے درمیان field کیسی ہوتی ہے؟
A: Always circular / ہمیشہ circular
B: Zero everywhere / ہر جگہ zero
C: Nearly uniform / nearly uniform
D: Random and changing direction / random اور changing direction
correct_answer: C | Nearly uniform / nearly uniform

question: What is a conductor?
urdu_translation: conductor کیا ہے؟
A: Material with no electrons / material with no electrons
B: Material that blocks all heat only / material that blocks all heat only
C: Material that cannot be charged / material that cannot be charged
D: Material in which charges can move freely / material جس میں charges freely move کر سکتی ہیں
correct_answer: D | Material in which charges can move freely / material جس میں charges freely move کر سکتی ہیں

question: Which is an electrical insulator?
urdu_translation: electrical insulator کون سا ہے؟
A: Copper / copper
B: Aluminium / aluminium
C: Silver / silver
D: Rubber / rubber
correct_answer: D | Rubber / rubber

question: Why do metals conduct electricity?
urdu_translation: metals electricity conduct کیوں کرتے ہیں؟
A: Their protons leave nuclei / ان کے protons nuclei چھوڑتے ہیں
B: They have no atoms / ان میں atoms نہیں ہوتے
C: They contain mobile free electrons / ان میں mobile free electrons ہوتی ہیں
D: Their electrons are completely fixed / ان کی electrons completely fixed ہوتی ہیں
correct_answer: C | They contain mobile free electrons / ان میں mobile free electrons ہوتی ہیں

question: Where does excess charge reside on an isolated conductor in electrostatic equilibrium?
urdu_translation: electrostatic equilibrium میں isolated conductor پر excess charge کہاں reside کرتی ہے؟
A: Only at the centre / صرف centre پر
B: On its outer surface / اس کی outer surface پر
C: Inside every nucleus / ہر nucleus کے اندر
D: Nowhere / کہیں نہیں
correct_answer: B | On its outer surface / اس کی outer surface پر

question: What is electrostatic discharge?
urdu_translation: electrostatic discharge کیا ہے؟
A: Steady current in a resistor / resistor میں steady current
B: Sudden movement of charge between objects / objects کے درمیان charge کی sudden movement
C: Heat transfer by convection / convection سے heat transfer
D: Light refraction / light refraction
correct_answer: B | Sudden movement of charge between objects / objects کے درمیان charge کی sudden movement

question: What is corona discharge?
urdu_translation: corona discharge کیا ہے؟
A: Melting of a metal wire / metal wire melting
B: Ionization of air near a highly charged pointed conductor / highly charged pointed conductor کے near air ionization
C: Reflection of sound / sound reflection
D: Charging by friction only / صرف friction سے charging
correct_answer: B | Ionization of air near a highly charged pointed conductor / highly charged pointed conductor کے near air ionization

question: What is lightning?
urdu_translation: lightning کیا ہے؟
A: A continuous direct current from a battery / battery سے continuous DC
B: A sound wave only / صرف sound wave
C: A type of convection current / convection current کی type
D: A large electrostatic discharge in the atmosphere / atmosphere میں large electrostatic discharge
correct_answer: D | A large electrostatic discharge in the atmosphere / atmosphere میں large electrostatic discharge

question: What is the purpose of a lightning conductor?
urdu_translation: lightning conductor کا purpose کیا ہے؟
A: To provide a safe low-resistance path to Earth / Earth تک safe low-resistance path provide کرنا
B: To attract lightning into a room / lightning کو room میں attract کرنا
C: To stop all clouds from forming / تمام clouds formation stop کرنا
D: To store charge permanently on a roof / roof پر charge permanently store کرنا
correct_answer: A | To provide a safe low-resistance path to Earth / Earth تک safe low-resistance path provide کرنا

question: Which is a safer action during a thunderstorm?
urdu_translation: thunderstorm کے دوران safer action کون سا ہے؟
A: Stand under the tallest tree / tallest tree کے under stand کریں
B: Hold a metal rod in an open field / open field میں metal rod hold کریں
C: Stay indoors and avoid isolated tall objects / indoors رہیں اور isolated tall objects avoid کریں
D: Swim in open water / open water میں swim کریں
correct_answer: C | Stay indoors and avoid isolated tall objects / indoors رہیں اور isolated tall objects avoid کریں

question: A 2 C test charge experiences 10 N force. What is electric field intensity?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل electric field intensity معلوم کریں: F = 10 N, q = 2 C
A: 20 N/C
B: 5 N/C
D: 12 N/C
correct_answer: B | 5 N/C

question: Which change produces the greatest Coulomb force?
urdu_translation: کون سی change greatest Coulomb force produce کرتی ہے؟
A: Reduce both charges and increase separation / both charges reduce اور separation increase کرنا
B: Increase separation only / صرف separation increase کرنا
C: Increase both charges and reduce their separation / both charges increase اور separation reduce کرنا
D: Make one charge zero / one charge zero کرنا
correct_answer: C | Increase both charges and reduce their separation / both charges increase اور separation reduce کرنا

question: Why are sharp points used on lightning conductors?
urdu_translation: lightning conductors پر sharp points کیوں use ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Sharp points have no electric field / sharp points کا electric field نہیں ہوتا
B: They increase building resistance / وہ building resistance increase کرتے ہیں
C: Charge density and electric field are greater near sharp points / sharp points کے near charge density اور electric field greater ہوتی ہیں
D: They reflect lightning as light / وہ lightning کو light کے طور پر reflect کرتے ہیں
correct_answer: C | Charge density and electric field are greater near sharp points / sharp points کے near charge density اور electric field greater ہوتی ہیں

question: What are Lichtenberg figures?
urdu_translation: Lichtenberg figures کیا ہیں؟
A: Circular magnetic field lines / circular magnetic field lines
B: Branching patterns produced by electrical discharge / electrical discharge سے produced branching patterns
C: Light spectra from a prism / prism سے light spectra
D: Heat-convection patterns / heat-convection patterns
correct_answer: B | Branching patterns produced by electrical discharge / electrical discharge سے produced branching patterns
